title: Indoor Environment + Outdoor Context + Ventilation
description: What's my indoor air quality and should I open windows?

targets.rawSql:
-- Indoor Temperature: Current value with unit conversion
-- Source: air_quality_observations from AirGradient sensor
SELECT
    observation_time AS time,
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit'
        THEN (temperature_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE temperature_c
    END AS value
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE observation_time >= NOW() - INTERVAL '6 hours'
  AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY observation_time ASC

-- Indoor Humidity: Current value
-- Comfort range: 30-60% (green)
-- Source: air_quality_observations from AirGradient sensor
SELECT
    humidity_pct AS value
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE humidity_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY observation_time DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Indoor CO2: Current value with threshold coloring
-- Thresholds: <800 green (good), 800-1200 yellow (elevated), >1200 red (high)
-- Source: air_quality_observations from AirGradient sensor
SELECT
    co2 AS value
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE co2 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY observation_time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Indoor PM2.5
panels.description: PM2.5 concentration. EPA thresholds: <12 Good, 12-35 Moderate, 35-55 USG, >55 Unhealthy

targets.rawSql:
-- Indoor PM2.5: Current value with EPA thresholds
-- EPA AQI breakpoints for PM2.5:
--   0-12 ug/m3: Good (green)
--   12-35 ug/m3: Moderate (yellow)
--   35-55 ug/m3: Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups (orange)
--   >55 ug/m3: Unhealthy (red)
-- Source: air_quality_observations from AirGradient sensor
SELECT
    pm25 AS value
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE pm25 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY observation_time DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Outdoor Temperature: Current value with unit conversion
-- Includes feels-like temperature in subtext
-- Source: weather_observations (OWM or NWS)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit'
        THEN (temperature_c * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE temperature_c
    END AS "Temperature",
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit'
        THEN (COALESCE(heat_index_c, wind_chill_c, temperature_c) * 9.0/5.0) + 32
        ELSE COALESCE(heat_index_c, wind_chill_c, temperature_c)
    END AS "Feels Like"
FROM silver.weather_observations
WHERE temperature_c IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY observation_time DESC
LIMIT 1

-- Outdoor Humidity: Current value
-- High humidity (>70%) discourages window opening
-- Source: weather_observations
SELECT
    humidity_pct AS value
FROM silver.weather_observations
WHERE humidity_pct IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY observation_time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Outdoor AQI
panels.description: EPA AQI: 0-50 Good, 51-100 Moderate, 101-150 USG, >150 Unhealthy

targets.rawSql:
-- Outdoor AQI: EPA scale (0-500)
-- Computed from PM2.5 if aqi_epa not available
-- EPA AQI Categories:
--   0-50: Good (green)
--   51-100: Moderate (yellow)
--   101-150: Unhealthy for Sensitive Groups (orange)
--   151-200: Unhealthy (red)
--   201-300: Very Unhealthy (purple)
--   301-500: Hazardous (maroon)
-- Source: outdoor_air_quality
SELECT
    -- Use aqi_epa if available, otherwise compute from PM2.5
    -- Simple linear approximation: AQI ~= PM2.5 * 2.4 for PM2.5 < 55
    COALESCE(
        aqi_epa,
        CASE
            WHEN pm25 <= 12 THEN (pm25 / 12.0) * 50
            WHEN pm25 <= 35 THEN 50 + ((pm25 - 12) / 23.0) * 50
            WHEN pm25 <= 55 THEN 100 + ((pm25 - 35) / 20.0) * 50
            WHEN pm25 <= 150 THEN 150 + ((pm25 - 55) / 95.0) * 50
            ELSE 200 + ((pm25 - 150) / 100.0) * 100
        END
    )::INTEGER AS value
FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
WHERE pm25 IS NOT NULL OR aqi_epa IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY observation_time DESC
LIMIT 1

panels.title: Ventilation Recommendation
panels.description: Should you open windows for fresh air?

targets.rawSql:
-- VENTILATION DECISION LOGIC
-- Recommends "OPEN WINDOWS" when ALL conditions are met:
--   1. Indoor CO2 > 800 ppm (would benefit from fresh air)
--   2. Outdoor temp: 18-26C (65-79F) comfort range
--   3. Outdoor humidity < 70%
--   4. Outdoor AQI < 50 (Good)
--   5. Precipitation probability < 20% in next 2 hours
--
-- Returns 1 for OPEN WINDOWS, 0 for KEEP CLOSED
-- The reason text is shown in a separate panel

WITH indoor_data AS (
    SELECT
        co2,
        pm25 as indoor_pm25
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE co2 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
outdoor_weather AS (
    SELECT
        temperature_c,
        humidity_pct
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE temperature_c IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
outdoor_aq AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            aqi_epa,
            CASE
                WHEN pm25 <= 12 THEN (pm25 / 12.0) * 50
                WHEN pm25 <= 35 THEN 50 + ((pm25 - 12) / 23.0) * 50
                WHEN pm25 <= 55 THEN 100 + ((pm25 - 35) / 20.0) * 50
                ELSE 150
            END
        ) AS aqi_value,
        pm25 as outdoor_pm25
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE pm25 IS NOT NULL OR aqi_epa IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
forecast_data AS (
    SELECT
        AVG(precip_probability_pct) AS precip_prob_2h
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
      AND precip_probability_pct IS NOT NULL
),
ventilation_check AS (
    SELECT
        i.co2,
        ow.temperature_c,
        ow.humidity_pct,
        oaq.aqi_value,
        COALESCE(f.precip_prob_2h, 0) AS precip_prob,
        -- Check each condition
        (i.co2 > 800) AS co2_elevated,
        (ow.temperature_c BETWEEN 18 AND 26) AS temp_comfortable,
        (ow.humidity_pct < 70) AS humidity_ok,
        (oaq.aqi_value < 50) AS aqi_good,
        (COALESCE(f.precip_prob_2h, 0) < 20) AS no_rain_expected
    FROM indoor_data i
    CROSS JOIN outdoor_weather ow
    CROSS JOIN outdoor_aq oaq
    CROSS JOIN forecast_data f
)
SELECT
    CASE
        WHEN co2_elevated
             AND temp_comfortable
             AND humidity_ok
             AND aqi_good
             AND no_rain_expected
        THEN 1
        ELSE 0
    END AS value
FROM ventilation_check

panels.title: Ventilation Factors
panels.description: Status of each factor in the ventilation decision

targets.rawSql:
-- VENTILATION FACTORS TABLE
-- Shows current status of each condition used in ventilation decision
-- Criteria for "OPEN WINDOWS":
--   1. Indoor CO2 > 800 ppm
--   2. Outdoor temp: 18-26C
--   3. Outdoor humidity < 70%
--   4. Outdoor AQI < 50
--   5. Precip probability < 20% (next 2h)

WITH indoor_data AS (
    SELECT co2
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE co2 IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
outdoor_weather AS (
    SELECT temperature_c, humidity_pct
    FROM silver.weather_observations
    WHERE temperature_c IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
outdoor_aq AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(
            aqi_epa,
            CASE
                WHEN pm25 <= 12 THEN (pm25 / 12.0) * 50
                WHEN pm25 <= 35 THEN 50 + ((pm25 - 12) / 23.0) * 50
                ELSE 100
            END
        )::INTEGER AS aqi_value
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE pm25 IS NOT NULL OR aqi_epa IS NOT NULL
    ORDER BY observation_time DESC
    LIMIT 1
),
forecast_data AS (
    SELECT
        COALESCE(AVG(precip_probability_pct), 0)::INTEGER AS precip_prob_2h
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '2 hours'
)
SELECT
    'Indoor CO2' AS "Factor",
    i.co2::TEXT || ' ppm' AS "Current",
    '>800 ppm' AS "Target",
    CASE WHEN i.co2 > 800 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END AS "Met"
FROM indoor_data i
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Outdoor Temp',
    ROUND(ow.temperature_c, 1)::TEXT || ' C',
    '18-26 C',
    CASE WHEN ow.temperature_c BETWEEN 18 AND 26 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM outdoor_weather ow
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Outdoor Humidity',
    ow.humidity_pct::INTEGER::TEXT || '%',
    '<70%',
    CASE WHEN ow.humidity_pct < 70 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM outdoor_weather ow
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Outdoor AQI',
    oaq.aqi_value::TEXT,
    '<50 (Good)',
    CASE WHEN oaq.aqi_value < 50 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM outdoor_aq oaq
UNION ALL
SELECT
    'Rain Forecast (2h)',
    f.precip_prob_2h::TEXT || '%',
    '<20%',
    CASE WHEN f.precip_prob_2h < 20 THEN 'Yes' ELSE 'No' END
FROM forecast_data f

-- UPCOMING CONDITIONS
-- Shows forecast summary for next 6-12 hours
-- Helps plan when conditions might be suitable for ventilation

WITH forecast_windows AS (
    SELECT
        CASE
            WHEN valid_time < NOW() + INTERVAL '3 hours' THEN 'Next 3h'
            WHEN valid_time < NOW() + INTERVAL '6 hours' THEN '3-6h'
            WHEN valid_time < NOW() + INTERVAL '12 hours' THEN '6-12h'
        END AS time_window,
        temperature_c,
        humidity_pct,
        precip_probability_pct,
        valid_time
    FROM silver.weather_forecasts
    WHERE valid_time BETWEEN NOW() AND NOW() + INTERVAL '12 hours'
      AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT
    time_window AS "Period",
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit'
        THEN ROUND(MIN(temperature_c) * 9.0/5.0 + 32, 0)::TEXT || '-' ||
             ROUND(MAX(temperature_c) * 9.0/5.0 + 32, 0)::TEXT || ' F'
        ELSE ROUND(MIN(temperature_c), 0)::TEXT || '-' ||
             ROUND(MAX(temperature_c), 0)::TEXT || ' C'
    END AS "Temp Range",
    ROUND(AVG(humidity_pct), 0)::TEXT || '%' AS "Avg Humidity",
    ROUND(MAX(precip_probability_pct), 0)::TEXT || '%' AS "Max Rain %"
FROM forecast_windows
WHERE time_window IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY time_window
ORDER BY
    CASE time_window
        WHEN 'Next 3h' THEN 1
        WHEN '3-6h' THEN 2
        WHEN '6-12h' THEN 3
    END

-- INDOOR TEMPERATURE TREND
-- Source: air_quality_observations from AirGradient sensor
-- Time-bucketed to 5-minute intervals for smooth display

SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit'
        THEN AVG(temperature_c) * 9.0/5.0 + 32
        ELSE AVG(temperature_c)
    END AS "Indoor"
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

-- OUTDOOR TEMPERATURE TREND
-- Source: weather_observations (OWM or NWS)
-- Time-bucketed to 5-minute intervals for alignment with indoor data

SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    CASE
        WHEN '${temp_unit}' = 'Fahrenheit'
        THEN AVG(temperature_c) * 9.0/5.0 + 32
        ELSE AVG(temperature_c)
    END AS "Outdoor"
FROM silver.weather_observations
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND temperature_c IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

-- INDOOR PM2.5 TREND
-- Source: air_quality_observations from AirGradient sensor
-- EPA thresholds shown as reference lines

SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    AVG(pm25) AS "Indoor PM2.5"
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND pm25 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

-- OUTDOOR PM2.5 TREND
-- Source: outdoor_air_quality (OpenWeatherMap Air Pollution API)

SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    AVG(pm25) AS "Outdoor PM2.5"
FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND pm25 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

-- INDOOR/OUTDOOR PM2.5 RATIO
-- Ratio > 1 means indoor air is worse than outdoor
-- Ratio < 1 means indoor air is better (filtration working)

WITH indoor_pm AS (
    SELECT
        time_bucket('30 minutes', observation_time) AS bucket,
        AVG(pm25) AS pm25
    FROM silver.air_quality_observations
    WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
      AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
      AND pm25 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
),
outdoor_pm AS (
    SELECT
        time_bucket('30 minutes', observation_time) AS bucket,
        AVG(pm25) AS pm25
    FROM silver.outdoor_air_quality
    WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
      AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
      AND pm25 IS NOT NULL
    GROUP BY 1
)
SELECT
    COALESCE(i.bucket, o.bucket) AS time,
    CASE
        WHEN o.pm25 > 0 THEN ROUND((i.pm25 / o.pm25)::NUMERIC, 2)
        ELSE NULL
    END AS "I/O Ratio"
FROM indoor_pm i
FULL OUTER JOIN outdoor_pm o ON i.bucket = o.bucket
WHERE i.pm25 IS NOT NULL AND o.pm25 IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: CO2 Trend (24h)
panels.description: CO2 levels with threshold reference lines at 800 and 1200 ppm

targets.rawSql:
-- CO2 TREND
-- Source: air_quality_observations from AirGradient sensor
-- Thresholds:
--   <800 ppm: Good (outdoor baseline ~420 ppm)
--   800-1200 ppm: Elevated - consider ventilation
--   >1200 ppm: High - ventilation recommended

SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    AVG(co2) AS "CO2 (ppm)"
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND co2 IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

panels.title: Humidity Comparison
panels.description: Indoor vs outdoor humidity with 60% indoor threshold

targets.rawSql:
-- INDOOR HUMIDITY TREND
-- Source: air_quality_observations from AirGradient sensor
-- Comfort range: 30-60% (shown with threshold line at 60%)

SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    AVG(humidity_pct) AS "Indoor Humidity"
FROM silver.air_quality_observations
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND humidity_pct IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1

-- OUTDOOR HUMIDITY TREND
-- Source: weather_observations
-- High outdoor humidity (>70%) is a factor against opening windows

SELECT
    time_bucket('5 minutes', observation_time) AS time,
    AVG(humidity_pct) AS "Outdoor Humidity"
FROM silver.weather_observations
WHERE observation_time >= $__timeFrom()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND observation_time <= $__timeTo()::TIMESTAMPTZ
  AND humidity_pct IS NOT NULL
GROUP BY 1
ORDER BY 1
